requestedText: Add the validation bounded context's provider-free interface registration boundary.

evidence: The interface module contains no runtime loading, reflection, plugin lookup, or dynamic dispatch registration.
The interface module is a new repository-local Rust boundary and this WI adds no external consumer or transport adapter.
The interface module adds no telemetry, monitoring, delivery, HTTP, scheduler, or provider integration.
The Contract authorizes this additive interface registration within the validation bounded context and excludes runtime, provider, production, and external-consumer changes.
